# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class ChandelierExitAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)

        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY")

        self._chandelier = self.chandelier_exit(self._spy, 20, 3, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._chandelier = ChandelierExit(20, 3)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._spy, self._chandelier, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._spy, self._chandelier, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.plot_indicator("Chandelier Exit", self._chandelier)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if not self._chandelier.is_ready:
            return

        bar = data.bars.get(self._spy)
        if not bar:
            return

        signal = self._chandelier.current.signal
        cost = self._chandelier.current.cost

        if not self._spy.invested and signal == OrderDirection.UP:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy, 1)
        elif self._spy.invested:
            if signal == OrderDirection.DOWN:
                self.liquidate(self._spy)
            elif bar.close < self._chandelier.lower_band:
                self.set_holdings(self._spy, -1)
